forbidden: No VWAP, RSI, MACD, FVG, CHoCH, DOM, MBP, MBO, delta, sweep logic, MA regime filters. Not a news strategy. Not a DVP clone.

ES.roll: Databento ES.v.0 volume-continuous (closest available match to NQ volume-crossover; not re-stitched from raw contracts in this phase)

or_valid_at: window close timestamp. No trade may use OR_HIGH/OR_LOW before that close.

entry_families.A_range: First 1m bar after OR complete whose range trades through the boundary. Fill = boundary +/- 1 tick (not the wick extreme). Gap-through open fills at that open +/- 1 tick.
entry_families.B_close_1m: First completed 1m close beyond the boundary. Entry at next 1m open +/- 1 tick.
entry_families.C_close_5m: Diagnostic. First RTH-aligned 5m close beyond the boundary. Entry at next 5m open +/- 1 tick.

stops.B_mid: SL = OR midpoint. Diagnostic on primary config only.
stops.C_atr: SL = entry +/- 1.0 * 14-day RTH ATR (prior completed days only). Diagnostic on primary config only. Reject if risk > 80 NQ pts / 40 ES pts.

same_bar_stop_and_target: AMBIGUOUS — do not assume target first

chrono.note: Predeclared. Train covers 2020 vol, 2021, 2022 bear, 2023-24. Holdout is 2025-2026 YTD.

primary_candidate.reason: Classic 15-minute RTH opening range, leak-safe 1m close confirmation, structural invalidation at the opposite boundary, 1R is the middle of the target family not the maximum. Declared before seeing Phase 38 P&L.

news.bls_0830_pm5: T-5m to T+5m around CPI/NFP 08:30 never overlaps RTH 09:30. Report 0 removed.
news.1000_et: No complete 10:00 calendar in-repo. Do not invent one. Report as limitation, not a hidden news filter.
news.fomc: Not used as a trade filter in Phase 38.

feature_cutoff: OR completion for width/ATR/gap/prior-day. Breakout bar only for timing/volume at the signal.
note: Phase 38 does not freeze. Candidate JSON only if a simple configuration survives costs and holdout.
